_doc: Exact-render quality gate; design, measurements and the reason for every threshold in docs/plans/quality-gate.md. Change a threshold only together with the measurement that justifies it.
_reviewed_known_flags: How many files the committed full-corpus baseline may record as flagged by an enforced rule. Each one is a reviewed, documented fidelity difference (docs/plans/quality-gate.md, Known flags); check fails when a baseline holds more.

ink_ratio.description: inked-pixel coverage, ours / Poppler's, outside [low, high] on a page where both have ink — content drawn at the wrong scale, missing or duplicated

ink_ratio_band.description: the same ratio outside the narrower [low, high] — report only (stroke-width and anti-aliasing differences on sparse pages reach 0.5 and 2.0)

content_ssim.description: SSIM over ink-bearing windows below max with a best-shift difference above min — report only (glyph rasteriser differences put 10 % of exact pages below 0.41)
